snippet.title: "There's Always a Madman: The MacGuffin" release date trailer "With a Vengeance"
snippet.description:
Wishlist and play the free demo for the interactive spy novel "There's Always a Madman: The MacGuffin" on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3372850/Theres_Always_a_Madman_The_MacGuffin

The game releases February 6, 2026 - get the MacGuffin before the MacGuffin gets you!
